plan.title: CAPEX Proposal Requires IP Number and CBA

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids in Master QCS.
Ensure the eRFX project configuration required by the case is enabled.
Allocate all 10 units on the line to Vendor B as required.
Verify that the full line is allocated to one vendor and the proposal value reflects 10 units at Vendor B's 90-unit bid.
Open the proposal form from the completed allocation.
Confirm that the proposal page opened.
Set Procurement Type to CAPEX, leaving the required IP number and CBA fields empty.
Verify that submission is refused while the CAPEX IP number and CBA requirements are missing.
